evidence.title: Emmy Awards leave broadcast TV for Prime Video in 2027 under six-year deal

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy Emmy broadcast contract records
occurrences.quote_span: The system has been in place since at least 1994, with the most recent eight-year contract expiring this year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy statement by chair Cris Abrego
occurrences.quote_span: "Having a dedicated home with Prime Video allows us to build on that legacy with unprecedented global reach and a broader commitment to the Television Academy and our mission throughout the year," he said.
occurrences.speaker: Cris Abrego
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy Emmy broadcast agreements and network broadcast records
occurrences.quote_span: The switch ends the traditional "wheel-deal" setup to broadcast the awards, where ABC, CBS, NBC and Fox took turns hosting the Emmys each year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon- Television Academy agreement or announcement on Emmy Awards streaming rights
occurrences.quote_span: In the release, Prime Video was named as the "permanent home" for the Emmys, in contrast to the rotating agreement in place years prior.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon- Television Academy agreement or announcement on Emmy Awards streaming rights
occurrences.quote_span: Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon- Television Academy agreement or announcement on Emmy Awards streaming rights
occurrences.quote_span: Under the agreement, Prime Video will stream the annual awards honoring the best in TV for free to all audiences, including nonsubscribers, in more than 240 countries and territories.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon and the Television Academy
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon- Television Academy agreement or announcement on Emmy Awards streaming rights
occurrences.quote_span: The Emmy Awards will leave its long-running broadcast network rotation for Amazon Prime Video in 2027 under a six-year exclusive global streaming deal, the e-commerce giant and the Television Academy announced on Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: Amazon and the Television Academy
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy statement by chair Cris Abrego
occurrences.quote_span: "Television has never been more global, and the Emmys should be a celebration that the world can share," Television Academy chair Cris Abrego said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: Cris Abrego
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Amazon- Television Academy agreement or announcement on Emmy Awards streaming rights
occurrences.quote_span: Prime Video's rights to the Emmys will begin with the 2027 ceremony.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

evidence.title: Emmy Awards exit broadcast TV, ink six-year Prime Video streaming deal

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy and Prime Video agreement announcing the Emmy Awards' exclusive global streaming rights
occurrences.quote_span: As part of a six-year deal, Prime Video will become “the exclusive global home of the Emmy Awards, ushering in a bold, innovative vision to propel the cultural icon into its next chapter,” an announcement said.
occurrences.speaker: Prime Video and Television Academy
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Emmy Awards broadcast and streaming distribution records
occurrences.quote_span: The Emmy Awards is going streaming — after more than 75 years on broadcast TV, the ceremony is making the move to Amazon Prime Video.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy Emmy Awards broadcast/streaming schedule for September 2027
occurrences.quote_span: The switch to Prime Video will begin with the September 2027 awards ceremony.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Prime Video and Television Academy access terms for the September 2027 Emmy Awards ceremony
occurrences.quote_span: Prime Video and the Television Academy said that next year’s ceremony won’t be behind a paywall and “will be free to view for audiences worldwide.”
occurrences.speaker: Prime Video and Television Academy
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy and Prime Video announcement describing the agreement's intended programming and fan experiences
occurrences.quote_span: The Television Academy and Prime Video touted the agreement, which they said will transform the Emmys “into a year-round cultural celebration” that will deliver “new experiences and entry points for fans to discover, engage with and celebrate what they love about TV.”
occurrences.speaker: Television Academy and Prime Video
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy historical Emmy Awards broadcast records
occurrences.quote_span: Since 1949, when it was launched, the Emmys has aired on a rotating basis among the major broadcast networks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights

occurrences.checkable_against: Television Academy and Prime Video announcement of the Emmy Awards streaming agreement
occurrences.quote_span: The Television Academy, which holds the annual awards gala, and Prime Video announced Tuesday that they inked a “historic, multiyear deal” that will make the streaming giant the new home for the ceremony.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Emmy Awards streaming rights
